what: After each Senate election, once its results have settled: adds its races to the training data, refits the model for the next election and remakes the back-tests. Between elections it finds nothing to do, which counts as working.
how_to_read: ok false: the last run failed, error says why, and the site keeps the last good figures. ok true but today later than overdue_after: the job has stopped running. The workflow link lists every run.
